title: Bil Bakalım Ben Kimim?
author: Övgü Tahberer Terleç
description: Imagine a milk bottle...Once filled with milk, it was just an ordinary kitchen item. But once empty, it disappeared down the recycling chute and embarked on a whole new adventure! Our bottle rolls along, crossing oceans and meeting different creatures all over the world. At each stop, a new friend and a new riddle letter await it. A zebra in Africa, a crocodile in the river, a mole underground, a polar bear in the ice, and finally, a sailor! Each one writes a letter introducing themselves: “Can you guess who I am?” The reader joins in the game, following the clues and making guesses.
